contract: 20 SubRip and 3 WebVTT documents whose time fields leave the 32-bit range (hours and seconds from 2^31 to beyond 2^64, and below -2^31), read and folded as subtitle-text reads and folds documents: compat::document::Reader on the candidate, FFmpeg's srt and webvtt demuxers on the reference
each case is pinned per target from that target's own reference run; a case passes when the candidate, the reference and the target's pin agree

the reader follows FFmpeg built with GCC for 32-bit ARM hard-float: a SubRip field saturates to the 32-bit signed range, and a WebVTT field's digits stop at 2^32 - 1 and read as a 32-bit signed number; FFmpeg for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu reads each of these documents otherwise, so every case is open there as a deliberate divergence
the documents are written by harness/subtitle_corpus.py; each target's expected folds are recorded independently from that target's reference worker
pending_module_requirements: a deliberate divergence: FFmpeg built with GCC for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu reads a SubRip time field beyond the 32-bit signed range as its value, held to the 64-bit signed range, modulo 2^32 (an hour of 2147483648 reads as -2147483648), and a WebVTT field whose digits exceed 2^32 - 1 as those digits, held to 2^64 - 1, modulo 2^32 (4294967296 reads as 0), where on 32-bit ARM both saturate; the reader follows FFmpeg on 32-bit ARM with GCC
